neighbours.label: a noun naming people by what they love or follow: X lovers, X fans, X enthusiasts
fire: This guide is for all the chocolate lovers who can never say no to dessert.
Hockey fans packed the bar to watch the final game.
For jazz enthusiasts, the festival offers three nights of free shows.
Every summer, wine lovers travel to the valley for the harvest.
The new trail is a dream come true for cycling fans.
As a lifelong Star Wars fan, I have seen every movie at least twice.
Opera lovers will appreciate the restored concert hall.
Gaming enthusiasts lined up overnight for the new console.
quiet: This guide is for anyone planning dessert after a heavy dinner.
The bar was packed to watch the final hockey game.
This year the jazz festival offers three nights of free shows.
Every summer, the valley celebrates the wine harvest with a fair.
The new trail will open for cycling next month.
Since childhood I have seen every Star Wars movie at least twice.
The restored concert hall reopens with an opera next week.
The new console went on sale at midnight in most stores.

notes: Probe: lovers 0.58, fans 0.50, fan 0.59, enthusiasts 0.60, native 0.38; 'dog owners' 0.31 and 'As a retired nurse,' 0.31 weaker; rewrites without the group noun <=0.07.
